key_insight: Multivariate HRV features from M-ECG signals showed modest ability to distinguish Veterans with TBI plus current PTSD from those with TBI alone, suggesting subtle autonomic differences may be detectable.
clinical_relevance: This work points to a potential noninvasive biomarker approach for characterizing PTSD-related autonomic burden in Veterans with TBI, but it is not yet ready for clinical use.
method: Boruta feature selection to identify informative HRV metrics
SHAP used to interpret feature contributions
evidence_signal: In 82 Veterans, the model achieved modest exploratory discrimination (AUC 0.663, 95% CI 0.540-0.778).
watch_item: The performance was only moderate and the study was preliminary, so larger independent validation is needed before any implementation.
paper_title: Multivariate Machine Learning Analysis of M-ECG-derived Heart Rate Variability in TBI Veterans, With and Without Current PTSD and Additional Psychiatric Comorbidity
